verdict.rationale: LightSprint publishes product docs at docs.lightsprint.ai, so agent-readable documentation is a fair question for this product, but a direct probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404). No other agent-oriented documentation of the product itself is evidenced. User-authored skill files such as design.md and review.md describe the user's own standards, not the product, so they are only an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
